The '''aunt''' of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Tyrak lineage]]. Tyrak's aunt [[Marriage/Legends|married]] her uncle, [[Tyrak's grandfather]], continuing the tradition of incestuous marriages in the family.
